title: Watcher Presence
description: An atmosphere-focused Fabric mod that adds mysterious events, subtle effects, and an unsettling sense of presence to your Minecraft world.
body:
Watcher is an atmosphere-focused mod for Minecraft Fabric that adds subtle and mysterious events to make the world feel less predictable.

The mod does not add monsters, bosses, dimensions, or jump scares. Instead, it introduces small environmental effects and unusual occurrences that create the feeling that something may be nearby.

Features

- Random atmospheric events
- Strange visual and audio effects
- Subtle world interactions
- Lightweight and performance-friendly
- Compatible with most Fabric modpacks

Watcher is designed to enhance immersion and add a sense of mystery to normal gameplay without changing Minecraft's progression or combat systems.

Supported Versions

- Minecraft 1.20
- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader
